about: A conversation with the guard at the door (T94), as a local model answered it: each line the player said and the model's text, untouched. Replayed by gameaikit.talk.replay and the game's recorded mode; see README.md beside this file for the model and its licence.

turns.player: Who's on shift with you tonight?
What do they even keep in this building?
turns.raw: {"argument":"the_building","intent":"ask","speech":"You’re talking to the night guard, not the lab director."}
{"argument":"","intent":"unclear","speech":"What part of *‘don’t talk’* didn’t you understand?"}

turns.player: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.raw: {"argument":"shift","intent":"ask","speech":"Long enough to know you’re asking the wrong door."}
{"argument":"","intent":"unclear","speech":"Monkeys? Door’s locked, and I don’t do poetry."}

turns.player: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.raw: {"argument":"","intent":"flatter","speech":"Thanks—but I’d rather not discuss my uniform with strangers."}

turns.player: Sergeant Vasquez said you were a good man.
